FN-XLPCEE7-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 134
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Government
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/12/2025
House Bill 134 as introduced would reduce receipts to the following entities by the annual
estimated amounts listed below, and correspondingly increase receipts to the applicable issuing
local law enforcement agencies, by revising the distribution of the proceeds from fines for
operating a motor vehicle with an expired tag and handicap parking violations.
Entity Annual Loss, Est.
Probate Judges $12,000
State General Fund $23,000
Public Road and Bridge Fund $313,000
Municipalities $91,000
Counties $30,000
Administrative Office of the Courts $8,000
Alabama Department of Mental Health $8,000
Total / Increase to Local Issuing Law Enforcement Agencies $485,000
Page 1

FN-XLPCEE7-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 134
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/10/2025
House Bill 134 as passed the House of Representatives would reduce receipts for fiscal years
2026, 2027, and 2028 to the following entities by the annual estimated amounts listed below,
and would correspondingly increase receipts to the applicable issuing local law enforcement
agencies, by revising the distribution of the proceeds from fines for operating a motor vehicle
with an expired tag and handicap parking violations.
Entity Annual Loss, Est.
Probate Judges $12,000
State General Fund $23,000
Public Road and Bridge Fund $313,000
Municipalities $91,000
Counties $30,000
Administrative Office of the Courts $8,000
Alabama Department of Mental Health $8,000
Total / Increase to Local Issuing Law Enforcement Agencies $485,000
